subject: problem including/using jQuery UI with Shiny

messages.author: 605c14114b1f1179
messages.subject: problem including/using jQuery UI with Shiny
parts:
Hello...

I am having trouble with the following (minimal) application

my_app_tmp <- list(
  ui = shinyUI(fluidPage(
    tags$head( tags$script(src = "http://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jqueryui/1.10.4/jquery-ui.min.js")),
    titlePanel('Problem when using JQuery UI with Shiny'),
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(dateRangeInput(inputId = 'dateRange', label = 'Date Range: (yyyy-mm-dd)', start = "2013-09-30", end = "2013-10-01")),  
      mainPanel(verbatimTextOutput("out")))
  )),
  server = shinyServer(function(input, output, session) { 
    output$out <- renderPrint({ paste("input$dateRange is", paste(as.character(input$dateRange), collapse = " to ")) })
    })
)
runApp(my_app_tmp)

When the line "tags$head( tags$script(src = "http://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jqueryui/1.10.4/jquery-ui.min.js")),"  is commented out, the app runs fine, but when i include the jQueryy UI in the header - using tags$head(tags$script(...)); as in the above code, i get the following error in the chrome javascript console:

"Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'empty' of undefined"

Can anyone replicate/resolve this issue? I am using shiny 0.10.0; with 
R version 3.1.0 (2014-04-10)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin10.8.0 (64-bit)

messages.subject: Re: problem including/using jQuery UI with Shiny
parts:
This question is related to the one posted here; and the cause of the problem/solution is the same. 
Basically, looking at the source code, i realized that In the file, jqueryui.R, on line 83-84, it says:

# IMPORTANT NOTE: If you update jqueryui, make sure you DON'T include the datepicker,
# as it collides with our bootstrap datepicker!

It was an unfortunate that i picked the datepicker out of ALL other shiny widget to test jQuery UI. :)
